versions.changelog: Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

credit-rights-voice 0.1.1

- Adds detailed SKILL.md with user-facing description and instructions.
- Describes how to turn a written credit-card benefits table into spoken clip packs, one per labeled rights cue.
- Outlines inputs, scope, safety requirements, voice handling (including clone consent), and multi-step remote workflow.
- Provides execution and recovery instructions using only the bundled mcp_client.py.
- Clarifies safe automatic update behavior and failsafe mechanisms.
- Contains clear references to additional workflow, billing, and update documentation.
